channels.notes: Manual candidate and publication workflows are authored. First-release qualification remains blocked by aniflow#64 and egolint#29; configured does not mean published or qualified.
crates.io publication is not configured. Cargo remains the version authority; a GitHub binary release does not publish the crate.
Homebrew, installers and other package-manager channels are not configured; each needs a separately reviewed repository-owned adapter.

rollback.instructions: Keep exact tags and assets immutable. Pin consumers to the last verified release and its digests, revert the defect, then prepare and qualify a corrective successor version. Revoke any affected external distribution through its owner. Retain the original evidence. Never force-move a version tag or overwrite an asset.
